name: AI Related Products – WooCommerce Recommendation
author: sharkthemes

sections.description:
Boost your sales with advanced intelligence. The most beneficial WooCommerce add-on for your online store. We have created a sophisticated algorithm to recommend products based on your individual customers’ interest. The ability to display your customers’ desired products repeatedly and in various ways will be a bonus. Your online store will have a greater chance of attracting and engaging customers as the use cases grow. You will consequently see a very well growth in your sales rate.
Demo
Documentaion

Why AI Related Products – WooCommerce Recommendation for Products Recommendation?

Increase in sales with AI-powered product recommendations tailored to customer interests. Engaged shoppers, increased conversions, and growth in your business effortlessly!
* We have built an AI Related Products Widget for Elementor.

Features

  • A shortcode for the classic editor is available, usable in any editor. (Limited functionality in the free version)
  • AI Related Products Block for Gutenberg. (Exclusive to the Pro version)
  • The ability to replace random related products on single product pages with AI-driven recommendations based on customer interest. (Limited functionality in the free version)
  • Item-based Collaborative Filtering for single product page and cart items suggestion. (Exclusive to the Pro version)
  • The product list layout automatically matches your shop page’s design, eliminating the need for additional design work. (Fully available in the free version)

How does it work?

Click here to learn how it works

Scopes

Click here to see the scopes of AI Related Products Plugin

See also Pro Version

Frequently Asked Question

Does this plugin boost my sales?

If you are using WooCommerce for your online store, AI Related Products helps you to grab the attention of your customers with products of their interest. This strategy is very effective to boost your sales.

Why should I use this plugin?

If you want to grow your online store, AI Related Products helps you boost sales by showing customers products they’re more likely to buy, all while saving you time with seamless integration.

How does the AI work?

If you are curious about the technology, AI Related Products uses item-based collaborative filtering to analyze customer behavior and suggest products they’re most interested in, creating a personalized shopping experience. It also uses sophisticated algorithm to recommend products based on your individual customers’ interest.

Is it easy to set up?

If you’re worried about complexity, AI Related Products integrates effortlessly with WooCommerce, Elementor, Gutenberg, and the classic editor, requiring no coding or design skills.

Can I customize the product recommendations?

If you want a consistent look, AI Related Products automatically matches your theme’s layout, so recommendations blend seamlessly with your store’s design.

How does this plugin improve sales?

If you want to increase revenue, AI Related Products displays products customers actually want, boosting engagement, reducing bounce rates, and encouraging repeat purchases.

Does it work with my existing WooCommerce theme?

If you’re concerned about compatibility, AI Related Products adapts to your store’s layout, ensuring a consistent and professional look without extra effort.

What makes this plugin different from others?

If you’re comparing options, AI Related Products uses advanced AI algorithms to provide highly accurate product recommendations, making it more effective than generic or random suggestion tools.

Can I use it with Elementor or Gutenberg?

If you’re using Elementor or Gutenberg, AI Related Products includes dedicated widgets for Elementor, blocks for Gutenberg, and shortcodes for the classic editor, making it versatile for any setup.

Is this plugin suitable for small businesses?

If you run a small business, AI Related Products is designed for stores of all sizes, helping you compete by offering personalized shopping experiences like larger retailers.

Can I use the plugin with the classic editor in the free version?

If you’re using the classic editor, the free version includes a shortcode that works in any editor, though with some limitations compared to the Pro version.

Does the free version support Gutenberg?

If you’re using Gutenberg, the AI Related Products Block is only available in the Pro version. The free version focuses on classic editor compatibility.

Can I replace random related products with AI suggestions in the free version?

If you want to replace random related products with AI-driven recommendations, the free version allows this but with limited functionality. Full features are unlocked in the Pro version.

Is the product list layout customizable in the free version?

If you’re concerned about design, the free version ensures the product list layout matches your shop page’s design, so no additional work is needed.

What advanced features are only in the Pro version?

If you’re considering upgrading, the Pro version includes the Gutenberg block, full AI-driven product and cart item suggestions, more advanced functionality for products recommendations and additional options on replacing random related products in single product page.
sections.installation:
Using The WordPress Dashboard

  • Navigate to the ‘Add New’ in the plugins dashboard
  • Search for AI Related Products
  • Click Install Now
  • Activate the plugin on the Plugin dashboard

Uploading in WordPress Dashboard

  • Navigate to the ‘Add New’ in the plugins dashboard
  • Navigate to the ‘Upload’ area
  • Select ai-related-products.zip from your computer
  • Click ‘Install Now’
  • Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard

Using FTP

  • Download ai-related-products.zip
  • Extract the ai-related-products directory to your computer
  • Upload the ai-related-products directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  • Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard
